items.title: 68154_Gus Johnson oral history interview
items.q: Sure, the first time I heard Chick in person was in Kansas City.

ctx.x: Sure, the first time I heard Chick in person was in Kansas City. See, he came to Kansas City and we were playing at the College Inn. McShann's band was at the College Inn. They came over to the auditorium. Ella Fitzgerald was with him.
